directive.gatingQuestion: Does AEP raising full-year guidance while Q2 operating EPS declined year over year constitute a material contradiction that must remain unresolved?
directive.whyItMatters: The active packet independently routes unresolved_material_contradiction to Deep Resolver; the classification should be adjudicated without taking over Alpha-owned underwriting, scoring, provenance or confidence work.
directive.preferredEvidencePath: Active AEP packet using the issuer Q2 2026 results and SEC Q2 2026 10-Q already present in packet lineage.
directive.successCondition: Determine whether a lower single-quarter operating EPS observation and higher forward full-year guidance are mutually inconsistent, while preserving execution, financing, load-conversion and regulatory risks.

adjudication.evidence: The active packet records a modest year-over-year Q2 operating-earnings/EPS decline and separately records raised full-year guidance, with primary issuer and SEC lineage. It also preserves non-gating risks around capital deployment, load conversion, financing, permitting and regulatory recovery.
adjudication.inference: A historical quarterly EPS decline and higher forward full-year guidance are not mutually exclusive. Guidance can reflect expected later-period earnings, rate-base investment, load conversion, timing and other forward assumptions. The tension is therefore an execution-dependence caution rather than a factual contradiction.
adjudication.gateImpact: Resolve unresolved_material_contradiction only. Preserve all Council Alpha-owned source-integrity, underwriting, factor, score, risk and data-confidence failures and all stated non-gating execution risks.

evidenceVsInference.observed: Q2 operating earnings/EPS declined year over year while full-year guidance was raised.
evidenceVsInference.inferred: The observations concern different time horizons and can coexist; future capital/load conversion assumptions remain execution risks rather than contradictions.

changedStrategy: First resolver adjudication: separated backward-looking quarterly performance from forward-looking full-year guidance instead of treating directional difference as logical inconsistency.
